verdict.rationale: Portkey is a gateway/observability platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis (agents connecting to Portkey via an official MCP server) applies, but the only relevant evidence (portkey-docs-17) shows Portkey acting as an MCP *client* — connecting to external/remote MCP servers — not Portkey itself exposing an official MCP server endpoint for agents to connect to. No documentation of a hosted or first-party Portkey MCP server was found.
